body:
## Pull request overview

Removes decommissioned Storybook links from the marketing site navigation and updates the primary “hero” CTA to point to the new demo domain (`demo.objectui.org`).

**Changes:**
- Removed the “Storybook” nav link from the shared site layout options.
- Updated the “Demo” nav link to `https://demo.objectui.org`.
- Updated the homepage hero CTA from “View Storybook” to “View Demo” and pointed it to `https://demo.objectui.org`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/site/lib/layout.shared.tsx | Removes Storybook from top nav and updates Demo link to the new demo domain. |
| apps/site/app/(home)/page.tsx | Updates homepage hero CTA label and URL to the new demo domain. |
